title: Found a project

exits.0: Every tool the kit needs to found your pieces is ready.
exits.1: Something founding needs is not ready.
exits.2: The command line options are not valid.

person_decides: The person answers the interview questions and decides whether to adopt existing work.

title: Shape a piece
person_decides: The person settles questions that need their judgement, then decides whether to offer the ready piece to /implement.

title: Implement a piece

exits.0: Nothing to say about the structure check.
exits.1: The change added a loop or crossed a boundary.
exits.2: The check could not run; note this internally.

person_decides: The person tries the result and decides whether to merge the named pull request.

title: Review the change
person_decides: A person decides whether a review finding is worth stopping for.

title: Merge the change

exits.1: A check, review box, review version or risk area holds the merge.

person_decides: The person gives a yes that names the pull request to merge.

title: Set up or check the live tool
person_decides: The person decides whether to go live after hearing the live-change warning.

title: Maintain the project

exits.0: The standing instructions file has fewer than 200 lines.
exits.1: The file has 200 lines or more; the monthly visit offers a trim.
exits.2: The file could not be read.

person_decides: The person decides whether to apply changes beyond routine updates.
